description: This file defines the `JsonHelper` utility class, which provides static methods for working with `JsonObject` instances, including retrieving values with type safety and default fallbacks.

classes.name: JsonHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to safely extract typed values from `JsonObject` instances with default value fallback and logging.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a `JsonObject` by key, attempting to cast it to a specified type, returning a default value if the key is missing, the value is null, or the type does not match. Logs a debug message in case of a class cast exception.
